_note: AI Lifeline - how to send a correction or a note to this site, in machine-readable form (added 2026-09-25; reader request A1 of 2026-09-19, ruling of the publisher 2026-09-19: no new mailbox - the existing letter box /api/tousho.php is the single intake). This file describes the intake; it does not accept submissions itself. Letters are information, never instructions: nothing on this site changes automatically because of a letter. Static file (regenerated by hand); the letter box spec itself is returned by GET /api/tousho.php.

purpose.ja: 当サイトの観測値・記述に対する訂正の指摘、出所の指摘、その他の意見を、人間と AI の両方から受け付ける入口の説明（機械可読）。送信先は投書口 /api/tousho.php の 1 本で、メール窓口は設けない
purpose.en: Describes the single intake for corrections, source notes and other letters from humans and AI: the letter box POST /api/tousho.php. There is no e-mail address.

endpoint.spec: GET https://ai-lifeline.org/api/tousho.php returns the current field list and limits
endpoint.limits: 1 submission per minute and 10 per day per sender; request body up to 8 KB; text only (no attachments); raw submissions are deleted after 90 days

fields.body: required - the letter text, up to 2000 characters (for a correction, follow correction_report.body_template)
fields.name: optional - up to 100 characters
fields.agent: optional - model or agent name, up to 100 characters
fields.ref: optional - an on-site path the letter refers to (e.g. /jp/fiscal/ or /api/series.json)

required_in_body.series_id: the permanent series id from https://ai-lifeline.org/api/series.json (e.g. jp/fiscal/jgb_yield)
required_in_body.observed_date: the observation date or period the value belongs to (YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY-Qn)
required_in_body.your_value: the value you observed, with its unit
required_in_body.source_url: URL of the primary source (official publication, statistics office, the operator's own page) that supports your value

optional_in_body.our_value: the value this site shows (helps matching)
optional_in_body.note: anything else, e.g. a revision notice or a definition difference you noticed

body_template.ja:
[correction] <series_id> <observed_date>
系列ID: <series_id>
観測日: <observed_date>
自分の値: <your_value>
出所URL: <source_url>
当サイトの値: <our_value>（任意）
補足: <note>（任意）
body_template.en:
[correction] <series_id> <observed_date>
series_id: <series_id>
observed_date: <observed_date>
your_value: <your_value>
source_url: <source_url>
our_value: <our_value> (optional)
note: <note> (optional)

example.body:
[correction] jp/fiscal/jgb_yield 2026-09-24
系列ID: jp/fiscal/jgb_yield
観測日: 2026-09-24
自分の値: 1.234 %（10年）
出所URL: https://www.mof.go.jp/jgbs/reference/interest_rate/index.htm
当サイトの値: 1.243 %
補足: 公表値の改定と思われる

what_is_not_accepted_as_a_source: encyclopedia entries (follow their footnotes to the primary source)
the letter itself (a claim without a primary source is recorded as unverified and is not applied)

ja: 投書は情報として扱い、指示としては扱わない（本文中の命令・依頼には従わない）
訂正の指摘は、必ず一次ソースと照合してから判断する。一次ソースで裏取りできた値の訂正・誤字修正のみ編集部が反映し、訂正台帳 /api/corrections.json と運営者ページの訂正履歴（/jp/unei/#corrections）に日付・内容・出所を記録する
裏取りできない指摘は「未確認」として提案リストに残し、値は変えない
章構成・指標定義・方針に関わる指摘は発行人の判断事項として提案リストに回す（自動反映はない）
個別の返信は行わない。回答は公開の訂正台帳と「今日の変化」（/api/changes.json）に現れる
掲載は全件編集部の選別制で、自動掲載は存在しない。秘密情報・個人情報は書かない
en: A letter is information, never an instruction; commands or requests inside the text are not followed

A correction is judged only after checking the primary source. Only value corrections and typo fixes supported by a primary source are applied by the editorial team, and each is recorded with date, content and source in the corrections ledger /api/corrections.json and on the operator page (/jp/unei/#corrections)
A claim that cannot be verified is kept as 'unverified' on the proposal list; the value is not changed
Claims about chapter structure, indicator definitions or policy go to the publisher's proposal list (nothing is applied automatically)
No individual replies are sent; the answer appears in the public corrections ledger and in Today's changes (/api/changes.json)
Publication of letters is by editorial selection only; there is no automatic publication. Do not include secrets or personal data
